title: Kiểm tra tuần 5: Câu phức và mệnh đề
title_en: Week 5 test: Complex sentences and clauses
passage:
In many countries, the way families support children's education has changed over the last fifty years. In the past, parents who had little schooling often left learning entirely to teachers. Today, most parents are expected to take an active role. Homework is checked at the kitchen table, and parents are invited to regular meetings at school.

Researchers at a university in Canada studied 2,000 families over ten years. They found that children whose parents read with them at least three times a week achieved higher marks in reading and writing. However, the amount of money a family spent on private lessons made only a small difference. The study also showed that grandparents played an important part, especially in families where both parents worked long hours.

Not everyone agrees with this trend. Some teachers worry that too much pressure from home can make students anxious. They suggest that parents should focus on encouraging curiosity rather than on test results. As a result, several schools now run free workshops which help parents support learning in a more relaxed way.

questions.q: At 9 o'clock last night, I ___ for my English test, so I didn't hear the phone.
questions.explain: Hành động đang diễn ra tại một thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ dùng quá khứ tiếp diễn.
questions.explain_en: An action in progress at a specific time in the past uses the past continuous.

questions.q: Students ___ attend every class usually get better results.
questions.explain: Danh từ chỉ người (students) làm chủ ngữ cho mệnh đề quan hệ nên dùng who.
questions.explain_en: A person noun (students) as the subject of a relative clause takes who.

questions.q: This is the school ___ my father studied forty years ago.
questions.explain: Where thay cho nơi chốn (= in which); dùng which thì phải có giới từ in.
questions.explain_en: Where replaces a place (= in which); with which you would need the preposition in.

questions.q: In Vietnam, English ___ in most primary schools from grade 3.
questions.explain: Tiếng Anh được dạy (bị động hiện tại đơn): is + V3.
questions.explain_en: English is taught (present simple passive): is + past participle.

questions.q: The new classrooms ___ last summer, so they are still very clean.
questions.explain: Có mốc quá khứ last summer và nghĩa bị động nên dùng were + V3.
questions.explain_en: There is a past time (last summer) and a passive meaning, so use were + past participle.

questions.q: If children ___ enough sleep, they find it hard to concentrate at school.
questions.explain: Câu điều kiện loại 0 nói sự thật chung: cả hai vế đều ở hiện tại đơn.
questions.explain_en: A zero conditional states a general truth: both clauses are in the present simple.

questions.q: We don't have ___ time before the exam, so let's revise quickly.
questions.explain: Time là danh từ không đếm được, câu phủ định dùng much.
questions.explain_en: Time is uncountable, and in a negative sentence we use much.

questions.q: The village school is very small. ___, its students achieve excellent results.
questions.explain: Hai ý đối lập (trường nhỏ nhưng kết quả tốt) nên dùng However.
questions.explain_en: The two ideas contrast (a small school but good results), so use However.

questions.q: Students who ___ attention in class usually understand the lesson better.
questions.explain: Cụm cố định: pay attention (chú ý).

questions.q: Parents play an important role in their children's ___.
questions.explain: Sau tính từ sở hữu children's cần danh từ: development (sự phát triển).
questions.explain_en: After the possessive children's we need a noun: development.

questions.q: In ___ families, grandparents, parents and children all live together in one house.
questions.explain: Extended family là gia đình nhiều thế hệ sống chung.
questions.explain_en: An extended family is several generations living together.

questions.q: In many countries, education is ___ until the age of 15, so all children must go to school.
questions.explain: Compulsory nghĩa là bắt buộc, khớp với ý 'must go to school'.
questions.explain_en: Compulsory means required, matching 'must go to school'.

questions.q: True, False or Not Given? Spending more money on private lessons greatly improved children's marks.
questions.explain: Bài đọc nói tiền học thêm chỉ tạo khác biệt nhỏ, trái với 'greatly improved'.
questions.explain_en: The passage says extra lessons made only a small difference, which contradicts 'greatly improved'.

questions.q: True, False or Not Given? Most of the families in the Canadian study lived in large cities.
questions.explain: Bài đọc không nói các gia đình sống ở đâu.
questions.explain_en: The passage does not say where the families lived.

questions.q: In the last paragraph, what does 'this trend' refer to?
options: parents taking a more active role in their children's education
questions.explain: Xu hướng được nói ở đoạn 1: phụ huynh tham gia tích cực vào việc học của con.
questions.explain_en: The trend from paragraph 1: parents taking an active part in their children's learning.
